onboarding.paragraph1: In the book of Acts, a man named Joseph was given a new name by the apostles: Barnabas — "son of encouragement." He had a gift for lifting others up with a kind word or a well-timed act of generosity.
onboarding.paragraph2: This journal gives you a new verse, a word of encouragement, and a small "Barnabas moment" to do for someone else — one day at a time. A new day unlocks every day; you can always look back on days you've already lived, but not skip ahead.
onboarding.paragraph3: Show up, be kind, and reflect a little. Stars, streaks, and badges are just there to notice how far you've come.
onboarding.paragraph4: We'll ask permission to send two gentle reminders each day — a morning verse, and an evening nudge to reflect — you can turn either off anytime from the Rewards tab.
onboarding.crisisRegionSubtitle: If you're ever in crisis, we want to show the right helpline for where you are. We'll guess from your device — but if you'd rather set it now, pick your country below. You can always change this later in Settings.

checkinPause.title: A Moment to Pause
checkinPause.body: In this heavy season, pause for a moment: what's one small thing you're grateful for right now, even if it's tiny? And think back — is there something that once felt impossible to get through, that you made it through anyway? You can again.

about.title: About {{brand}}
about.paragraph1: Barnabas Journal exists to put a little encouragement into your day — one verse, one quote, and one true story of someone showing up for another person, each day.
about.paragraph2: It's named for Barnabas, called "Son of Encouragement" in Acts 4:36 — a man who introduced the outcast, gave second chances, and stood by people others had given up on.
about.paragraph3: Our hope is simple: that this app helps you carry a little more hope into your day, and gives you an easy way to pass it on to someone else. No matter your background, your faith, or the season of life you're in, there's something here for you.

menu.shareAppMessage: I've been using {{brand}} — a daily verse, quote, and true story of encouragement. Thought you might like it too.

lookBack.title: Look back anytime
lookBack.text: The day navigator lets you revisit any day you've already lived. You can always look back, but you can't skip ahead of today.

jumpLinks.title: Jump straight to what you want
jumpLinks.text: The quick links under the day navigator — Verse · Word · Moment · Reflect — scroll you straight to that part of the page.

moreToExplore.title: More to explore
moreToExplore.text: The tabs up top hold a true Story, a Fact of the Day, your Journal of past entries, and everything you've saved to Favorites.

saveWhatMoves.title: Save what moves you
saveWhatMoves.text: Tap Save — or ☆ Save in a card's ••• menu — on any verse, quote, story, or fact to keep it in Favorites for later.

crisisRegion.title: Get the right crisis line
crisisRegion.text: We guess your country from your device to show the right crisis helpline. If it's ever wrong, go to Settings → Crisis Support Region and pick your country by hand.
